metadata.name: United Bank for Africa Plc
metadata.provenance: financials built 23-Nov-26 from UBA FY2025 & 9M 2026 NGX financial filings (Nov-26); quotes await [BBG] capture

financials_multi_year.source: UBA Plc FY2025 Audited Financial Statements (NGX), read 23-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY25 assets NGN 33.17tn, loans ~NGN 7.02tn, group customer deposits NGN 27.21tn (core NGN 23.07tn), NPL 7.67% (123.6% coverage).

9M26 assets NGN 34.96tn (+5.4% YTD), loans NGN 7.44tn (+6.0% YTD), deposits NGN 28.87tn (core 24.60tn), equity NGN 4.39tn, NII NGN 1.19tn (+2.7% YoY), PBT NGN 502.98bn, PAT NGN 401.60bn (-25.3% YoY as impairments jumped to NGN 272.12bn post-forbearance). Moody's Tier 1 17.2%, Stage 3 ~8.1%.

debt_maturities.source: Redeemed $300m 6.75% Eurobond on 19-Nov-2026 (XS2409171225); maintains active $1.5bn GMTN programme for potential 2027 issuance.

verdict.stance: Neutral / Pan-African Diversified Nigerian Tier-1 Bank Post-Nov-26 Redemption (B/B3)
verdict.summary: UBA redeemed its $300m 6.75% Eurobond cleanly at maturity on 19-Nov-26 (XS2409171225), backed by >50% ex-Nigeria pan-African assets (total NGN 34.96tn) and 17.2% Tier 1 capital. Post-forbearance Stage 3 NPLs stepped up to ~8.1% (9M26 provisions NGN 272.12bn, PAT -25.3% YoY to NGN 401.6bn), requiring monitoring alongside Nigerian sovereign ceiling.

positives: Cleanly redeemed $300m 6.75% Eurobond on 19-Nov-2026; liquid balance sheet (NGN 28.87tn deposits vs NGN 7.44tn loans, ~26% LDR).
Superior geographic diversification: 20 African countries (>50% of assets outside Nigeria) buffer domestic shocks.
Solid 17.2% Tier 1 capital (TCE/RWA 27.2%, equity NGN 4.39tn) and Fitch B / Moody's B3 Stable ratings.
negatives: Post-CBN forbearance expiration lifted Stage 3 NPL ratio to ~7.7%-8.1% and drove 9M26 impairment jump to NGN 272.12bn (PAT -25.3% YoY).
Ratings capped by Nigeria sovereign ceiling ('B'/'B3') given sovereign bond holdings & CBN cash reserves.

background.business_overview: Leading pan-African financial services group headquartered in Lagos operating in 20 African countries plus UK/US/France/UAE.
background.asset_perimeter: Nigeria parent (~50% assets) plus UBA Africa subsidiaries (~50%+ assets) and international wholesale units.
background.ownership_governance: NGX-listed (UBA); Tony Elumelu / Heirs Holdings anchor; regulated by CBN.

recent_drivers: 19-Nov-26: Repaid & delisted $300m 6.75% senior Eurobond (XS2409171225) at maturity.
9M26 (NGX): Assets NGN 34.96tn, Deposits NGN 28.87tn, Loans NGN 7.44tn, NII NGN 1.19tn, PAT NGN 401.6bn (-25.3% YoY on NGN 272.12bn provisions).
